description:
The Office of Program Management and Policy, part of the Bureau of Administration's Office of Logistics Management (A/LM/PMP), is looking to procure barcodes from a leading company that specializes in the design and manufacture of durable, preprinted
barcode labels. These barcodes must be versatile enough for use in both office and residential settings, and they should be durable
enough to withstand various climates, including, but not limited to, tropical, desert, temperate, mountain, continental, polar, and tundra
environments.
